old: ResumeFrames (SLYamlStream sp_start) [FrameLevel.map nv] sp_v) ∨ PackAlt sc)
new: ResumeFrames (SLYamlStream sp_start) [FrameLevel.map nv] sp_v) ∨ PackAlt sc)
-- Item 471 (ω-pay-births) step (c), PRICED NOT LANDED: the MAPPING lane's still-open tail
-- (items 193/196–198 named it): a dedent `?` at an enclosing column `k < n` is a SIBLING
-- entry in the mapping the collection stands in; the ancestors' marks below `k` keep their
-- `:` line across that entry.  `MarkedColsIn sc ns` holds every mark; the closed ones (`k ≤ nv`)
(h_mapTail : (∃ ns : List Nat, RegisterWitness.MarkedColsIn sc ns ∧ ∀ nv ∈ ns,
∀ k : Nat, nv < k → k < n →
∀ sp_i sp_v : SurfPos, SIndent k sp_m sp_i → SBlockMapEntry k sp_i sp_v →
ExplValueLine sp_start nv sp_v) ∨ PackAlt sc)
